events.title: ESCAPE
events.description: A boundary-breaking fusion of human movement and physical structures.

events.title: Scorched Earth
events.description: A murder. An interrogation. A clouded world of fantasy and fear.

events.title: LEGENDS (of the Golden Arches)
events.description: A rip-roaring ride plunging two best friends into the depths of the Chinese afterlife, crossing genres, realities, and theatrical convention with infectious zest.

events.title: Bleachers
events.description: Stories of loneliness and togetherness sit side by side in this new disability-led dance-theatre work by Sprung Ensemble — a collective of 10 d/Deaf and disabled artists from Bundjalung Country in Northern NSW.

events.title: Werewolf
events.description: Attention: Multiple new occurrences confirmed. Healthy citizens report to safehouses by sunset.

events.title: Dead as a Dodo
events.description: Deep within the underworld, two skeleton friends, a Dodo and a boy, tirelessly dig for fresh bones. Their ancient skeletal forms are deteriorating, and without them, they will disappear completely. One day, something peculiar happens: the Dodo miraculously sprouts feathers! A wave of transformation begins, shattering the established order of the dead.

events.title: This Show is a Joke!
events.description: Hold onto your cowpats! After nearly two decades of seriously silly nonsense, Matt and Rich (aka The Listies) have whipped up their most ridiculous show yet — a turbo-charged mash-up of fan favourites, slapstick, songs, and a fresh batch of brand-new, freshly hatched gags. It's a comedy extravaganza for kidults aged 4 to 4 million (dinosaurs welcome).

events.title: Betsy Balloon and the Very Great Terrible Flood
events.description: They’re cheerful, a bit money-mad and life is on the up. But when the world turns against balloons, their world pops and Betsy must start a new life in a faraway city with her eccentric uncle, Hercules Snark, an inventor of mostly half-finished things.

events.title: Generations & Dynasties: The Brady Family
events.description: A powerful afternoon of storytelling, captivating conversation, and exploring how cultural legacy is passed down the generations through music.

events.title: Generations & Dynasties: The Briscoe Sisters
events.description: A heartfelt and unforgettable afternoon of conversation, connection and soulful music.

events.title: Pasifika Made
events.description: Where Ancestral Knowledge Meets Contemporary Pacific Arts

events.title: The Complete Bach Catalogue for Organ
events.description: From quiet contemplation to awe-inspiring grandeur.

events.title: The Scramble
events.description: Two men hit the mat with scrappy energy, in a charged physical duet where exertion, resistance and care collide. They twist, tussle, grapple and brace — toe to toe in a work of dance-meets-wrestling that bristles with male intimacy, contest, and connection.

events.title: Attenborough's Ocean in Concert
events.description: Sir David Attenborough’s greatest message of hope brought to life, live by Camerata.

events.title: Common People Dance Eisteddfod
events.description: Seven teams. One trophy. Unlimited glory. Let the battle begin!

events.title: Community Choir: The Musical
events.description: A heartwarming and hilarious tale written by Emma Dean, directed by Belinda Raisin, and performed almost entirely by local community members — many stepping on stage for the very first time.

events.title: Human Nature: All The Hits Live
events.description: Human Nature are one of Australia’s most successful pop vocal groups, known for flawless harmonies, slick showmanship and feel-good live energy.

events.title: Dance with Tom
events.description: Join Tom for a joyful live stage experience celebrating Language from the Yugambeh Region, Culture and storytelling through movement, music and dance.

events.title: Family Fun Day supported by Brisbane Airport
events.description: Pack your sunscreen, grab the kids and glide onto the Village Green in Verso Projects. Festival Village, South Bank for a first-class day of free family-friendly performances, entertainment and activities.

events.title: The Aboriginal Centre for Performing Arts: Community Showcase
events.description: More than a performance, it's real time creation

events.title: Agnes Obel
events.description: Don't wait, this one-night-only concert is sure to be a sell-out.

events.title: Maestro 7: Symphonic Dances
events.description: From folk steps to final farewells, Queensland Symphony Orchestra's Symphonic Dances concert is built around the joy of dance.

events.title: ACO: Mozart's Last Symphonies
events.description: A complex, joyous swansong from one of history's greatest classical music geniuses.

events.title: Brisbane Cheryomushki
events.description: Witty and affectionate, this satirical operetta is a musical gem.

events.title: ICEHOUSE
events.description: Back by popular demand, ICEHOUSE return with their legendary live energy and timeless hits like ‘Great Southern Land’, ‘Crazy’, and ‘Electric Blue’.

events.title: PNAU
events.description: ARIA Award-winning electronic duo PNAU have become one of Australia’s most influential acts, evolving from Sydney’s underground scene to global charts.

events.title: Missy Higgins
events.description: Missy Higgins, one of Australia’s most beloved voices, brings her iconic hits ‘Scar’, ‘The Special Two’, ‘Steer’ and ‘Futon Couch’ to the stage.

events.title: Lord Mayor's City Hall Concerts: UQ Music Gala
events.description: Join us for a sensational gala hour, where you’ll be dazzled by some of The University of Queensland's finest emerging artists.

events.title: Lord Mayor's City Hall Concerts: East of West
events.description: Storytelling spun over rich traditional rhythms.

events.title: Lord Mayor's Children's Program: TheatreDome
events.description: Amidst a theatrical storm, can our contestants perform?

events.title: Talk of the Town: True crime, death and the live body
events.description: We are living through a cultural obsession with true crime.

events.title: Talk of the Town: Collective bodies, international spaces
events.description: Originating in the 18th Century, international circus arts have evolved beyond the Big Top.

events.title: Dead Puppet Society: Sculptures & Sips Workshops
events.description: Love art and design with a side of champagne? Dive into one of Dead Puppet Society’s Sculptures & Sips workshops. Create and take home your own handmade creation, connect with like-minded makers, and work alongside Dead Puppet Society artisans in their Fabrication Workshop — where the puppets and props from their productions are imagined, designed, and brought to life.

events.title: Dead Puppet Society: Puppet Construction Workshop
events.description: Puppet Construction takes puppetry manipulation skills to the next level by allowing young people to design, craft and build their very own tabletop sized puppet.

events.title: Love Me Again Market: Morningside
events.description: Love Me Again Market is curating a special Brisbane Festival edition combining pre-loved fashion, music, community and great vibes all in one unforgettable day.

events.title: Transurban Bridge to Brisbane
events.description: Run, walk or wheel for something bigger!

events.title: Flipside Circus Workshops
events.description: Step right up and give some circus skills a go!

events.title: Create your own Superhero with DESIRAI: Festival Village
events.description: Awaken your inner superhero – digital Illustration with DESIRAI

events.title: Hula Hoop Workshop with Vulcana Circus
events.description: Join this relaxed, drop-in hula hoop workshop facilitated by Vulcana Circus, where you can learn new tricks, build confidence, improve your skills or simply have fun. Suitable for all experience levels.

events.title: Wake Up & Sing!: ¡Buenos Días! Sing with Latin Choir Brisbane
events.description: Morning sounds different when people sing together.

events.title: Wake Up & Sing! with One Voice Brisbane
events.description: Changing the world… one voice at a time.

events.title: Wake Up & Sing! with the cast of Shel We
events.description: Join in the chorus as we start the day with song and play!

events.title: Wake Up & Sing! with Cheep Trill Choir
events.description: Come along, raise your voice, and discover why singing together is one of life's simple pleasures.

events.title: Physical Movement Workshop Arts Workshop with the cast of ESCAPE
events.description: A fusion of contemporary dance, acrobatics, and theatre.

events.title: Dance Workshop with the cast of Shel We
events.description: Delight in this upbeat, full of mischief enchanting dance style.

events.title: Community Serenades
events.description: Join us for an afternoon of dancing with Bring a Plate.
